# also accept full team names (최소 핵심)
FULLNAME = {

    "BOSTONCELTICS":"BOS",
    "BROOKLYNNETS":"BKN",
    "CHARLOTTEHORNETS":"CHA",
    "CHICAGOBULLS":"CHI",

def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    s = s.strip().upper()
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)
    return s

def _norm_compact(s: str) -> str:
    # remove punctuation/spaces for robust matching
    s = s.strip().upper()
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", s)
    return s

def to_abbr(x) -> str | None:
    """
    Robust team -> canonical ABBR (30 teams).
    Accepts: already-abbr, "LA Clippers", "New York Knicks", "Trail Blazers", "76ers" 등.
    """
    if x is None:
        return None

    s = str(x)
    if not s.strip():
        return None

    # 1) exact-like
    s1 = _norm(s)
    if s1 in ABBR:
        return s1
    if s1 in ALIASES:
        return ALIASES[s1]

    # 2) compact normalize
    sc = _norm_compact(s)
    if sc in ABBR:
        return sc
    if sc in ALIASES:
        return ALIASES[sc]
    if sc in FULLNAME:
        return FULLNAME[sc]

    # 3) last chance: try common patterns
    # e.g. "New York" -> NYK, "Oklahoma City" -> OKC
    if "NEWYORK" in sc:
        return "NYK"
    if "OKLAHOMA" in sc:
        return "OKC"
    if "LOSANGELES" in sc and "CLIP" in sc:
        return "LAC"
    if "LOSANGELES" in sc and "LAK" in sc:
        return "LAL"

    return None
